response.sql:
WITH circuit_counts AS (
  SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count
  FROM races
  GROUP BY circuitId
), shares AS (
  SELECT circuitId,
         race_count,
         1.0 * race_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) AS share
  FROM circuit_counts
), ranked AS (
  SELECT circuitId,
         race_count,
         share,
         share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) AS excess_share
  FROM shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)
)
SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, excess_share
FROM ranked
ORDER BY excess_share DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average share is taken across circuits that have at least one race, since the grouping produces one row per circuitId present in races.
